notes.title: Gagundle Bundle + Giveaway
notes.notes:
You probably, at any point, had the following problem: "Wow! This X game by Gagonfe is really good! I want to buy the other ones" or "I want to have all games made by Gagonfe, but the price is too expensive". If you've identified with any of the previous scenarios, your problems are gone with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20255/Gagundle/]Gagundle[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710436/63ec13e1af2a6a3a3204772a5ff8e12ea00489e0.png[/img]

Gagundle is a bundle with all games made by Gagonfe so far! Now you can pay just once for the games: Gemini, Bob Help Them, and Colorful Colore with a huge discount for you to be okay with your wallet and have a lot of fun.

So, don't waste any more time, because the bundle is already available, and you can buy it now and have a blast.

And in case you can't buy the bundle, join our [url=https://twitter.com/Gagonfe/status/1369393810707513353]giveaway[/url] of 10 copies on Twitter
and have a chance to win!

But that's it, people.

Thanks for reading,

Gagonfe.
